summary: Static camera and a nearly still standing woman across the cut strip, with no visible pops, flicker or clipping; only a minor stiff-pose note.

faults.what: Her face is a blank, neutral stare in profile from the first frame; there is no visible change of expression or eye movement to show the smile going off, so the 'something changed' beat is not readable.
faults.fix: Add a small eye shift or brow and mouth change plus a slight head turn in the first half second of the shot.
